name: HfO2 monoclinic, synthetic
citation: R. Ruh and P. W. R. Corfield. Crystal Structure of Monoclinic Hafnia and Comparison with Monoclinic Zirconia. Journal of the American Ceramic Society 53 (1970), 126–129.
recommendation: experimental source candidate; native FEFF and numerical validation pending
method: Experimental single-crystal X-ray diffraction by Weissenberg techniques; three-dimensional least-squares refinement. Publisher abstract explicitly reports seven Hf–O distances.

synthesis_conditions.description: Needlelike crystal grown from a lithium molybdate melt (publisher abstract). Exact synthesis temperature/pressure not verified.

notes: One independent Hf site, multiplicity4, complete seven-coordinate monoclinic oxygen shell. This is not tetragonal, cubic, ferroelectric orthorhombic or amorphous hafnia.
Preserve all seven short bonds, including the distinct 2.1710 and2.1721A neighbors separated by only~0.0011A. Do not round away or merge close paths.
Original source omits occupancy column; full occupancy is the ordered parser interpretation.
This is an experimental1970 refinement. Coordinates are preserved with their original precision; the source does not establish transferability to a measured sample.
measurement_conditions_evidence: Measurement temperature and pressure are not recorded in downloaded CIF or the verified publisher abstract; do not replace them with flux-growth conditions.

occupancy.interpretation: Occupancy column absent; unit occupancy is parser interpretation, not an explicit refined occupancy.
